title: Whole genome de-novo assembly and annotation protocol for Apostichopus japonicus genome
author: Jihoon Jo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gmabu2e

steps.title: Trim Raw Illumina Reads
steps.instruction: Process all Illumina raw-reads using Trimmomatic and Trim Galore.

steps.title: Correct Sequence Errors
steps.instruction: Run ALLPATHS-LG to correct errors in the raw Illumina sequences.

steps.title: Perform De-novo Genome Assembly
steps.instruction: Execute de-novo genome assembly using Platanus, comparing its performance against other assemblers such as SOAPdenovo and ALLPATHS-LG.

steps.title: Close Scaffold Gaps
steps.instruction: Use GapCloser (a module of SOAPdenovo2) to close remaining gaps in the resulting scaffolds.

steps.title: Evaluate Assembly Quality
steps.instruction: Run CEGMA and BUSCO to assess the assembly.

steps.title: Mask Repeats
steps.instruction: Run RepeatMasker using the Repbase TE library and a de novo repeat library constructed by Repeat Modeler.

steps.title: Perform Ab-initio Gene Prediction
steps.instruction: Conduct ab-initio gene prediction using AUGUSTUS, utilizing hints from splicing alignment of transcripts to the repeat-masked assembled genome via BLAT and PASA.

substeps.instruction: Collect RNA-seq data to obtain the AUGUSTUS training set

steps.title: Map Homologous Proteins
steps.instruction: Map homologous proteins from other species (sourced from Uniprot) to the repeat-masked assembled genome using tBLASTn with an E-value < 1 x 10^-5.

steps.title: Predict Genes in Aligned Sequences
steps.instruction: Use GeneWise to search for precise spliced alignment and gene structure in the sequences aligned in the previous protein mapping step.

steps.title: Build Homology-based Gene Model
steps.instruction: Map RNA-seq reads to the repeat-masked assembled genome using TopHat, then build the homology-based gene model using Cufflinks.

steps.title: Integrate Gene Sets
steps.instruction: Integrate all gene sets generated from the ab-initio prediction, protein mapping, GeneWise prediction, and RNA-seq mapping steps, ensuring no redundant gene sets are included.
